interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] [b]Two soup noodle packets[/b] and [b]one tin of canned meat[/b], please.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Binh was here, was he? He gets confused about money. Always has.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] I keep the neighborhood debt book. Without it, people would forget what they owe.

response_choices: Then you can check it together.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Of course. I only want the figures to be right. It is a lot of responsibility.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Thank you. If Binh leaves any paper with you, send him to me.
